title: A batch job with a filter dialog: the query parameter is packed, not an object
instruction: Ground with get_knowledge(topic="sysoperation"). In the sandbox model write a SysOperation trio (contract + service + controller) for a batch job whose dialog offers query ranges. The contract's query parm must carry BOTH [DataMemberAttribute('Query')] and [AifQueryTypeAttribute('_packedQuery', queryStr(<an existing AOT query>))], and its value is a packed STRING. The service unpacks it with new Query(SysOperationHelper::base64Decode(contract.parmQuery())) and iterates a QueryRun. Storing a Query OBJECT on the contract FAILS this case: the contract is serialised into the batch record, so a non-packable member is lost between the dialog and the batch run - which looks like the filter being ignored in batch but working interactively. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
